title: Range Sum Query 2D Immutable
summary: Construct a read-only matrix query object.
statement: Construct a read-only matrix query object. For each query, return the sum of the cells in the inclusive rectangle from [r1,c1] to [r2,c2].

examples.explanation: The full sum is 8. The right column sums to 2.
The rectangle contains just the negative cell.
Both rectangles fit in a single row.

constraints: Matrix is rectangular with 1–200 rows and columns and entries in [−10000,10000]. At most 10000 queries, with 0 ≤ r1 ≤ r2 < rows and 0 ≤ c1 ≤ c2 < columns.
hints: Conceptual: Several rectangles can share the same accumulated totals.
Directional: Precompute sums from the upper-left corner.
Implementation: Subtract the strips above and left of a query. Add back their intersection once.
complexityAnalysis: O(mn) initialization time and space. O(1) per sumRegion call.
